name: Narrowest factorization of 30! into increasing factors
description: construct() -> strictly increasing positive integers a_1 < ... < a_t with 2 <= t <= 30 and product exactly 30!. Minimize a_t - a_1; the optimum is 27. For n = 30 the optimum span is 27, so the task recovers an optimal factorization.

sources.locator: Daniel Berend and Charles F. Osgood, On the equation P(x) = n! and a question of Erdős (1992). Crossref records inspected (Berend and Osgood 1992; Bui, Pratt and Zaharescu 2023). Erdős Problem #393 page inspected: f(n) is the least m with n! = a_1...a_t, a_1 < ... < a_t = a_1 + m; Erdős and Graham did not know whether f(n) = 1 infinitely often, and f(n) = m has o(N) solutions n <= N for each m. OEIS A388302 inspected: f(30) = 27. For n = 30 the optimum span is 27, so the task recovers an optimal factorization.
Erdős Problem #393 (open); statement, history and current bounds reviewed 2026-09-24.
